title: FBI Search Recovered Classified Records at Mar-a-Lago
description_short: The supplied account says the FBI’s August 2022 Mar-a-Lago search recovered classified material; it does not identify specific records.
description_medium: The supplied account says the FBI recovered classified material during its August 2022 search of Mar-a-Lago. The linked Washington Post article timed out, so this entry does not claim that particular records contained special-access markings or nuclear information. It also keeps the search separate from the broader total of records recovered during the investigation.
description_long: The supplied account concerns classified material recovered during the FBI’s August 2022 search of Mar-a-Lago. The linked Washington Post article timed out, and the packet does not identify the specific records, their markings, or which documents, if any, contained nuclear information. The original title’s specific claims about special-access programs and nuclear content therefore cannot be confirmed from the available material. The record also distinguishes material recovered in the August search from the total of classified records recovered over the broader investigation. It does not establish that any documents were exposed to a foreign government or obtained by an adversary. This description is limited to the reported recovery of classified material. An accessible copy of the article or underlying court filings identifying the documents and markings would be needed to describe their contents or the number attributable to that search. The packet contains no search inventory or warrant to check against that reporting.
